Definition: Dibon, the name of three places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Dibon was a town in Moab east of the Jordan, taken by Israel and rebuilt by the children of Gad, and the prophets later pronounced judgment on it. The name means wasting.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Dibon stands as a warning and a witness at once: God gave it to His people, and when Moab trusted in its own strength, the prophets said its glory would come down to the dust. The same God who gives a city can take it away.
RelatedEvents: The Defeat of Sihon and Og
